extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for structuring stories using Christopher Vogler's adaptation of the mythic 'Hero's Journey'—including character archetypes and the twelve narrative stages for screenwriting and storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of mythic structure and archetypes
rubrics_metrics.description: Most stories can be boiled down to a series of narrative structures and character archetypes, described through mythological allegory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vogler's core thesis: apply mythic patterns and archetypal roles to organize plot and character; widely recommended for student screenwriters and storytellers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hero (archetype)
rubrics_metrics.description: Someone who is willing to sacrifice his own needs on behalf of others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Central protagonist whose journey drives the plot; demonstrates growth through sacrifice and transformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentor (archetype)
rubrics_metrics.description: All the characters who teach and protect heroes and give them gifts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the hero with supplies, knowledge, confidence, or tools needed to begin/advance the adventure (ties into 'Meeting with the Mentor' stage).

rubrics_metrics.name: Threshold Guardian (archetype)
rubrics_metrics.description: A menacing face to the hero, but if understood, they can be overcome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Functions as obstacles or tests early in the journey that the hero must confront and learn from; not always pure antagonists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Herald (archetype)
rubrics_metrics.description: A force that brings a new challenge to the hero.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Triggers the Call to Adventure or signals change; initiates the story's inciting incident.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shapeshifter (archetype)
rubrics_metrics.description: Characters who change constantly from the hero's point of view.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creates uncertainty about motives/alliances and sustains narrative tension through ambiguity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shadow (archetype)
rubrics_metrics.description: Character who represents the energy of the dark side.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Embodies antagonistic forces or the hero's darker impulses; often the principal antagonist or internal opposite.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ally (archetype)
rubrics_metrics.description: Someone who travels with the hero through the journey, serving a variety of functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports the hero practically or emotionally; helps reveal facets of the hero and moves the plot forward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trickster (archetype)
rubrics_metrics.description: Embodies the energies of mischief and desire for change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disrupts complacency, inverts expectations, provides humor or catalyzes transformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Ordinary World (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero is seen in their everyday life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish the hero's baseline, status quo, and what will be at stake if things change; grounds the audience emotionally.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Call to Adventure (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The initiating incident of the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An event or message that disturbs the Ordinary World and invites the hero to change or act.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal of the Call (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero experiences some hesitation to answer the call.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows the hero's fears, doubts, or obligations; builds empathy and internal conflict before commitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting with the Mentor (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero gains the supplies, knowledge, and confidence needed to commence the adventure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentor provides guidance, tools, lessons, or reassurance that prepares the hero for the journey ahead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crossing the First Threshold (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero commits wholeheartedly to the adventure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A point of no return where the hero leaves the familiar world and enters the special world of the story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tests, Allies, and Enemies (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero explores the special world, faces trial, and makes friends and enemies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Series of challenges that build skills, reveal character, and form alliances or rivals; develops plot momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach to the Innermost Cave (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero nears the center of the story and the special world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A preparatory phase where stakes rise and the hero readies for the central ordeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Ordeal (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero faces the greatest challenge yet and experiences death and rebirth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The central crisis or confrontation that forces deep transformation (literal or symbolic); often the emotional climax.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reward (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero experiences the consequences of surviving death.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After surviving the Ordeal the hero gains a reward—knowledge, power, treasure, or reconciliation—that acknowledges the transformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Road Back (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero returns to the ordinary world or continues to an ultimate destination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decision/phase where the hero begins the return journey; may include renewed pursuit or new obstacles.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Resurrection (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero experiences a final moment of death and rebirth so they are pure when they reenter the ordinary world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A final test that proves the hero's transformation and readies them to reenter society changed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Return with the Elixir (stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The hero returns with something to improve the ordinary world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resolution: the hero brings back a benefit, lesson, or boon that heals or improves the community or restores balance.
